messages:
kevin: Drafting internal release note and quick ops checklist — can product + oncall review? Deploy window Fri 02:00-03:00 PT. Canary plan: 10% for 15m -> 50% for 10m -> 100% if green. Pin: rw-inference-v1.2.3 -> rw-inference-v1.2.4. Rollback triggers: error rate > 2% OR p95 latency > 800ms for 5m.

sara: Thanks — will skim. Two asks: 1) call out that embeddings compat unchanged, 2) tone down the "performance improvements" claim to "latency improvements under load". Otherwise 👍 :eyes:.

mike: Ops note — ensure dedicated pools have capacity reserved. I'll pre-warm 2 nodes and keep autoscale disabled during canary. Also want healthcheck tweak: increase readiness timeout to 45s for this rollout.

olivia: Adding a short internal blurb for #general and the release digest. Draft below — PTAL: 
```
Heads up: Infra team will deploy a runtime update (rw-inference v1.2.4) on Fri 02:00 PT. No user-facing changes expected. Expect ~5-10m of canary validation, then gradual ramp. Contact oncall if you see increased errors or latency.
```

emma: Tiny nit: in the RN bullets can we add the exact schema compatibility note? Something like "model input/output schema unchanged; no prompt changes required."

kevin: Good call, added that to RN. Updated canary timeline in the deploy play: 10m @10% -> 15m @50% -> 20m @100%. Will run a smoke against the smoke prompt set after each stage.

mike: Rollforward criteria? If canary shows < 0.5% errors and p95 < 600ms for 15m, we open to 100%. Otherwise auto-rollback. Also set a manual gate at 50% for product signoff.

kevin: Noted — will add manual gate at 50% requiring a :thumbsup: from @sara or @emma in the thread.

deploy-bot: Command received: `/deploy start rw-inference v1.2.4 --window=2025-11-07T02:00PT --canary=10,50,100 --canary-durations=10m,15m,20m --manual-gate=50% --notify=#eng-oncall`

deploy-bot: Preflight checks: capacity OK, build artifact verified, db migrations none. Queuing deploy for Fri 02:00 PT.

olivia: Internal announce copy for #general (short): "Deploying performance update to inference runtime Fri 02:00 PT. No customer-facing changes expected. Monitoring active; reach out in #incidents if you notice regressions." :shipit:

kevin: Final checklist before I pin RN and schedule deploybot: 1) product signoff (sara/emma) 2) ops confirm pre-warm (mike) 3) oncall aware (olivia) 4) RN snippet for #general (olivia)

sara: Signoff from product: ✅ (softened language, embeddings note included).

mike: Ops: ✅ pre-warm done and readiness timeout set.

emma: Oncall ack: ✅. I'll be monitoring dashboards during the window.

kevin: Great — I'll pin the internal RN and set the deploybot timer. Leaving the manual gate at 50% for product thumbs-up. Thanks all. :pray:
